title: SelectSim — Evolutionary dependencies in cancer
text: SelectSim R package infers evolutionary dependencies .e co-mutations mutual exclusivities — functional alterations across cancer genomes. estimates expected co-mutation frequency gene pair individual mutation frequencies per-sample tumor mutation burden (TMB), evaluates significance simulation based null model. SelectSim Method method accounts heterogeneous tumor types, tissue specificities, distinct mutational processes covariate-aware weighting scheme. Significance assessed weighted effect size frequency-stratified FDR control generated via simulation. package accompanies manuscript: Iyer , Petrovic M, Sesia D, Nanni L, Mina M, Ciriello G (2026).
